name: Hero Catalog
description: Complete definitions for every recruitable and promotable hero class.

Guardian.name: Guardian
Guardian.description: A heavily protected frontline hero who controls enemy attention and intercepts attacks aimed at vulnerable allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the weakest ally (25% max HP, until broken), then gains +6 Threat, Intercept, and +15 Defense for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat and +8 Defense; +2 more Defense per living ally.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.description: An armored defender who blocks routes, challenges dangerous enemies, and protects adjacent allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 120% Attack damage; applies -35% Attack for 2 turns (-15% to others), then gains +10 Threat and Intercept for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +5 Threat, +20 Immunity, and +3 Defense per living ally.

Royal Bastion.name: Royal Bastion
Royal Bastion.description: An immovable champion whose presence shields the entire formation and denies enemies control of the frontline.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the whole party (22% max HP, until broken) and grants +12 Defense and +12 Magic Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +7 Threat; the whole party gains +8 Defense and +8 Magic Defense.

Paladin.name: Paladin
Paladin.description: A sacred protector who combines defensive techniques with healing, cleansing, and protection from hostile magic.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 280% Attack, cleanses all harmful effects, and grants +15 Magic Defense for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20 Healing and +8 Magic Defense; skill heals also grant an 8% max HP barrier. After every action, Merciful Surge heals 1 wounded ally.

Dawn Warden.name: Dawn Warden
Dawn Warden.description: A radiant guardian who turns divine protection into powerful counterattacks and party-wide barriers.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the whole party (18% max HP, until broken) and grants +35 Counter Chance and +75 Counter Power for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat; the party gains +15 Healing and +15 Immunity. When an ally takes damage, gains +20 Counter Chance for 2 turns.

Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.description: A dependable melee combatant who builds momentum through sustained attacks and adapts to different weapons.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 180% Attack damage and gains +20% Damage for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Each basic attack adds +6% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +30%) for the rest of the battle.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description: An aggressive warrior who trades defense and health for escalating damage, speed, and resistance to control.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 10% Max HP; hits one random enemy 3 times for 88% Attack damage per hit, then gains +30% Damage for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Deals up to +50% Damage as Health drops below 50%, strongest near defeat.

Blood Champion.name: Blood Champion
Blood Champion.description: A relentless destroyer who becomes most dangerous when wounded and can overwhelm entire enemy groups.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 125% Attack damage and heals for 50% of damage dealt.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Defeating an enemy heals 18% max HP and grants +20% Damage for 3 turns. Survives the first lethal hit each encounter at 1 HP.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description: A precise combatant who parries attacks, exploits openings, and excels when fighting a single opponent.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 170% Attack damage, then gains +100 Counter Chance and +100 Counter Power for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat; +15 Critical Chance when attacking the same enemy again, and +25 Evade against a foe that keeps targeting it.

Swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
Swordmaster.description: A peerless weapon specialist who converts perfect timing and positioning into devastating finishing attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 185% Attack damage; the hit is guaranteed critical and ignores 35% Defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10 Critical Chance and +12 Counter Chance; critical hits restore 6 mana.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.description: A fast, elusive hero who uses stealth, flanking, and critical strikes to eliminate priority targets.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 230% Attack damage with +50% Critical Chance, ignoring 20% Defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: +35% Damage against enemies below 50% Health; always +10 Evade and -1 Threat.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description: A burst-damage specialist who marks isolated targets and attacks from concealment for lethal results.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the weakest enemy for 150% Attack damage, gaining up to +200% Attack as its Health falls; applies 15% Vulnerability for 3 turns if it survives.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The first hit on a new target gains +35 Critical Chance and +25% Damage.

Nightblade.name: Nightblade
Nightblade.description: A master killer who moves between shadows, chains executions, and disappears before enemies can retaliate.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 105% Attack damage (+70% Attack below 50% Health); a kill grants +100 Evade for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Defeating an enemy grants +15% Damage for 3 turns and +35 Evade for 2 turns.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.description: A disruptive skirmisher who uses feints, smoke, theft, and misdirection to manipulate the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 80% Attack damage and applies -25% Attack for 3 turns; gains +35 Evade for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12 Evade and +8 Critical Chance; a successful evade grants +20% Damage for 2 turns.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.description: An untouchable saboteur who creates decoys, steals enemy advantages, and turns hostile plans against their owners.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 160% Attack damage, applies 20% Vulnerability for 2 turns, and gains +100 Evade for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18 Evade; a successful evade restores 12 mana and grants +30% Damage for 2 turns.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.description: A ranged hunter who scouts hostile territory, marks targets, and gains advantages from terrain and distance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 140% Attack damage and applies 24% Vulnerability for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10% Dexterity; +20% Damage against enemies that haven't acted yet this wave.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.description: A patient marksman who sacrifices mobility for exceptional range, armor penetration, and single-target damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 270% Attack damage with +25% Critical Chance, ignoring 45% Defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12 Critical Chance; +25% Damage on the Sniper's first action each wave.

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.description: A legendary shooter who exposes hidden weaknesses and can decide a battle with one perfectly prepared shot.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the weakest enemy for 180% Attack damage; the hit is guaranteed critical and ignores 35% Defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +8 Critical Chance; critical hits apply 4% Vulnerability to the target for 3 turns.

Beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
Beastmaster.description: A versatile hunter who fights alongside an animal companion and coordinates attacks with it.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy 2 times for 95% Attack damage per hit, then gains a 12% Max HP barrier until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat and +10% Damage. Below 35% Health, gains a 20% Max HP barrier once per 4 turns.

Wild Warden.name: Wild Warden
Wild Warden.description: A master of the hunt who commands a powerful bonded beast and turns the surrounding wilderness into an ally.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 2 times for 68% Attack damage per hit, then gains +20% Damage for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Each allied basic attack adds +4% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +32%) for the rest of the battle.

Cleric.name: Cleric
Cleric.description: A divine support hero who restores health, removes harmful conditions, and protects the party from supernatural threats.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 220% Attack and grants +18 Magic Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20 Healing. Skill heals restore 8 mana and cleanse the target's harmful effects. After every action, Twin Mercy delivers a two-pulse heal to 1 wounded ally.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.description: A dedicated healer who provides efficient restoration, blessings, and emergency protection for wounded allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party for 100% Attack, then applies Regeneration (45% Attack per turn) for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +25 Healing; healing beyond what's needed becomes a barrier (50% of the excess). After every action, Shared Grace splits a heal between 2 wounded allies.

High Priest.name: High Priest
High Priest.description: A supreme spiritual healer whose miracles can rescue an entire party from defeat and restore fallen heroes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Revives one fallen ally at 45% HP; if none has fallen, heals the weakest ally for 350% Attack.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 party Regeneration; all healing is +40% stronger while the High Priest is below 35% Health. After every action, Miracle's Wake heals 1 wounded ally (+50% below 35% Health).

Inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
Inquisitor.description: A battle cleric who exposes corruption, dispels enemy magic, and punishes cursed or supernatural foes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 160% Attack Magic damage, removes its buffs, and applies 22% Vulnerability for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18% Magic Damage; +22% Damage against any enemy with a harmful effect active.

Demon Hunter.name: Demon Hunter
Demon Hunter.description: A relentless purifier who seals hostile powers and specializes in destroying summoned, undead, and corrupted enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 200% Attack damage plus +75% Attack bonus and Silences it for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20 Immunity; resisting a harmful effect grants +25% Damage for 3 turns.

Mage.name: Mage
Mage.description: A fragile spellcaster who spends mana to deal area damage, alter the battlefield, and control groups of enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 115% Attack damage; the primary target takes +55% Attack damage (170% total).
stats.skill_psv_desc: +15% Damage while mana is 50 or higher.

Elementalist.name: Elementalist
Elementalist.description: An offensive caster who combines fire, frost, lightning, and earth to exploit weaknesses and create reactions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 75% Attack damage, then applies 12% Attack DoT and a random -15% Attack, -15 Evade, or 12% Vulnerability for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +6% Damage; casting the active skill restores 8 mana.

Archon.name: Archon
Archon.description: A living conduit of elemental power who reshapes large areas and chains multiple elements into catastrophic spells.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 95% Attack damage, applies 10% Vulnerability for 3 turns, and restores 8 mana to the party.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +8% Magic Damage; gains 5 mana whenever an enemy takes DoT.

Arcanist.name: Arcanist
Arcanist.description: A technical mage who manipulates raw magic through barriers, teleportation, interruption, and spell amplification.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 190% Attack damage, Silences it for 2 turns, and refunds 30 mana.
stats.skill_psv_desc: +25% Damage against silenced enemies.

Grand Magus.name: Grand Magus
Grand Magus.description: A master of pure sorcery who rewrites the rules of combat by altering range, cost, timing, and magical effects.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the party +22% Damage and +18 Evade for 3 turns, restores 20 mana to everyone, and applies -20% Attack to all enemies for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Each active skill cast adds +8% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +24%) for the rest of the battle.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description: A charismatic support hero who maintains performances that strengthen allies, weaken enemies, and shape party morale.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party for 60% Attack and grants +24% Damage for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +8% Damage; each active skill cast adds +8% more (Momentum, stacks up to +20%) for the rest of the battle. After every action, Restorative Refrain splits a heal between 2 wounded allies.

Minstrel.name: Minstrel
Minstrel.description: An inspiring performer who sustains healing melodies, resource recovery, and long-lasting party enhancements.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party for 75% Attack, restores 15 mana, then applies Regeneration (40% Attack per turn) for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +25 Healing and +25% stronger Regeneration effects; skill heals restore 5 mana. After every action, Threefold Ballad splits a 3-pulse heal between 2 wounded allies.

Virtuoso.name: Virtuoso
Virtuoso.description: A brilliant artist who layers several performances at once and transforms party coordination into overwhelming tempo.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party for 120% Attack, restores 20 mana, then grants +26% Damage, +12 Defense, and +12 Magic Defense for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The whole party always gains +13% Damage and +12 Healing. After every action, Grand Healing Chorus splits a heal between 3 wounded allies.

Skald.name: Skald
Skald.description: A martial storyteller whose battle chants improve offense, courage, and resistance while pressuring nearby enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +24% Damage, +30 Immunity, and +15 Critical Chance for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +10 Critical Chance; any allied critical hit restores 4 mana to the Skald.

War Chanter.name: War Chanter
War Chanter.description: A commanding voice on the battlefield who drives allies into heroic action and breaks the resolve of enemy formations.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +30% Damage and +20 Critical Chance for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +14% Damage. Whenever an ally defeats an enemy, the War Chanter gains +5% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +25%) for the rest of the battle.

Engineer.name: Engineer
Engineer.description: A tactical specialist who deploys devices, traps, and consumable inventions to prepare and control the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 150% Attack damage and applies -15% Attack for 3 turns, then shields the party for 10% Max HP until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat, +5 Defense, and +10% Damage; gains an 8% Max HP barrier at each wave start.

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description: A magical inventor who equips allies with enchanted devices, protective constructs, and adaptable utility tools.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the strongest ally +28% Damage, +15 Critical Chance, and +10 Magic Defense for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The whole party always gains +8% Damage and +6 Magic Defense.

Master Artificer.name: Master Artificer
Master Artificer.description: A visionary creator whose autonomous constructs and legendary equipment can redefine the party's capabilities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 110% Attack damage, shields the party for 15% Max HP until broken, then grants 25% Attack Regeneration for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Regeneration; the whole party gains +8 Defense and +10% Damage. After every action, Repair Sequence splits a 2-pulse heal between 2 wounded allies.

Machinist.name: Machinist
Machinist.description: A battlefield operator who deploys turrets, explosives, and mechanical weapons to control key positions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the weakest enemy 4 times for 75% Attack damage per hit, ignoring 20% Defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always ignores 10% Defense on basic attacks; each basic attack adds +5% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +25%) for the rest of the battle.

Siege Architect.name: Siege Architect
Siege Architect.description: A master of heavy machinery who constructs fortified positions and brings overwhelming mechanical firepower.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 140% Attack damage, shields the party for 30% Max HP until broken, and gains +25 Defense and +25 Magic Defense for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18 Defense, +12 Magic Defense, and +8 Threat; each basic attack adds +4% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +28%) for the rest of the battle.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description: A disciplined combatant who generates focus through movement, counters, and attack combinations before spending it on advanced techniques.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 165% Attack damage, restores 8 mana to the party, and gains +20 Counter Chance for 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12 Counter Chance; each basic attack adds +10% Damage (stacks up to +100%) for the rest of the battle.

Martial Artist.name: Martial Artist
Martial Artist.description: A mobile melee specialist who changes stances, completes combos, and counters predictable enemy attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 200% Attack damage, ignoring 25% Defense, then gains +20 Evade for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10 Evade and +15 Counter Chance; each active skill cast adds +10% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +24%) for the rest of the battle.

Grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
Grandmaster.description: A flawless combatant who flows freely between stances and turns enemy aggression into decisive counterattacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the party for 20% and the Grandmaster for 45% max Health until broken, then grants +10 Threat, +100 Counter Chance, +140 Counter Power, and +40 Evade for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +16 Defense, +16 Magic Defense, +8 Threat, +20 Evade, +8 Regeneration, +25 Counter Chance, and +45 Counter Power.

Mystic.name: Mystic
Mystic.description: A spiritual support fighter who channels focus into barriers, cleansing techniques, and restorative energy.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 240% Attack, cleanses harmful effects, grants a 20% Max HP barrier, and +15 Magic Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +22 Healing; the party gains +5 Magic Defense. Gaining mana heals the weakest ally for 2% of their max HP. After every action, Spirit Balance heals 2 wounded allies, favoring the lowest Health.

Enlightened One.name: Enlightened One
Enlightened One.description: A transcendent guardian who shares focus with allies and protects the party through perfect spiritual balance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Equalizes the party's Health, shields everyone (28% max HP, until broken), and grants +30 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +15 Immunity. When mana would overflow past 100, heals the whole party for 10% max HP. After every action, Balanced Restoration heals 3 wounded allies, favoring the lowest Health.

Druid.name: Druid
Druid.description: A nature-bound hero who builds harmony by cycling abilities and uses it to transform creatures, terrain, and weather.

stats.skill_act_desc: Below 70% ally Health, heals the party for 125% Attack plus 25% Attack Regeneration; otherwise hits all enemies for 125% Attack plus 25% DoT. Lasts 2 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12 Healing and +10% Damage; each active skill cast adds +5% more Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +20%) for the rest of the battle. After every action, Renewing Seed heals 1 wounded ally immediately, then applies a 2-turn Regeneration.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description: An adaptable combatant who assumes animal forms suited to defense, mobility, or close-range damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the Shapeshifter +35% Damage, +25 Evade, and +10 Defense for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat, +10 Defense, and +8 Magic Defense; each active skill cast adds +12% Damage (Momentum, up to +24%) for the battle.

Primal Avatar.name: Primal Avatar
Primal Avatar.description: An embodiment of the wild who combines traits from multiple beasts and transforms without sacrificing momentum.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 110% Attack damage; grants 30% party and 45% self Max HP barriers, then +22% Damage, +20 Defense, and +20 Magic Defense for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +14% Damage, +14 Defense, +10 Magic Defense, +10 Threat, and +10 Regeneration; up to +25% more Damage as Health drops below 50%.

Grove Keeper.name: Grove Keeper
Grove Keeper.description: A nature caster who grows healing plants, restrains enemies with roots, and creates favorable terrain.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party for 80% Attack, then grants 45% Attack Regeneration and applies -18% Attack to all enemies for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +6 Regeneration and +18 Healing; +12 Defense while at full Health. After every action, Verdant Regrowth splits a heal between 2 wounded allies (60% as a 3-turn Regeneration).

Archdruid.name: Archdruid
Archdruid.description: A supreme keeper of nature who commands forests and storms, causing the battlefield itself to aid the party.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 135% Attack damage and heals the party for 90% Attack, then applies 30% Attack DoT and Regeneration for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +25 Healing; the party gains +4 Regeneration and +15 Healing. DoT is +25% stronger. After each action, Restorative Rain heals 3 wounded allies (50% as 2-turn Regeneration), doubled below 35% Health.

Warlock.name: Warlock
Warlock.description: A forbidden caster who accumulates corruption to fuel unusually powerful curses and summons at personal risk.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 8% Max HP; hits the strongest enemy for 230% Attack damage, then applies 45% Attack DoT and gains +20% Damage for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20% Damage and +10 Lifesteal; suffers 2 Decay damage after each basic attack.

Hexbinder.name: Hexbinder
Hexbinder.description: A curse specialist who weakens enemies and places delayed hexes that trigger when specific conditions are met.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 120% Attack damage, then applies 70% Attack DoT and 15% Vulnerability for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: DoT effects are +30% stronger; +20% Damage against any enemy with a harmful effect active.

Doomcaller.name: Doomcaller
Doomcaller.description: A master of inevitable ruin whose curses spread between enemies and convert their failures into further calamities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 50% Attack damage, then applies 20% Attack DoT and 10% Vulnerability for 4 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: DoT effects are +15% stronger; defeating an enemy restores 12 mana.

Demonologist.name: Demonologist
Demonologist.description: A dangerous summoner who sacrifices health or control to bind powerful infernal creatures.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 12% Max HP; hits one random enemy 3 times for 100% Attack damage per hit, then gains a 15% Max HP barrier until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18% Damage; suffers 2 Decay damage after each basic attack. Casting the active skill grants an 8% max HP barrier.

Infernal Lord.name: Infernal Lord
Infernal Lord.description: A supreme binder who commands several demons, transfers corruption to them, and unleashes their full forbidden power.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 10% Max HP; hits every enemy 3 times for 50% Attack damage per hit and heals for 35% of damage dealt.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12% Damage and +15 Lifesteal; defeating an enemy heals 12% max HP.
